features: Analog Turbo HD ColorVu turret — 4-in-1 (TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS) switchable output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Up to 20 m white supplement light with smart supplement light
3D DNR / 2D DNR, 4 programmable privacy masks and motion areas
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE70DF3T-MF is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu turret with 24/7 full-color imaging (F1.0), 130 dB WDR, up to 20 m white supplement light and 4-in-1 TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS output over coax in a metal IP67 housing. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE70DF3T-MF_Datasheet_20240129.pdf).
